title: 2 Blocks to Broadway, Sleeps 6, King Bed, Pool
description:
You'll wake up to pool views in this upscale king suite two blocks from Broadway. Steps from Nashville's best nightlife, room for the whole crew — sleeps 6, with accessibility features and boutique-hotel design throughout. Parking available, but you won't need a car here. Walk to Bridgestone Arena, the Ryman, and Nissan Stadium. Blackout curtains and a noise machine keep it dark and quiet. TVs in both rooms, full kitchen, laundry, and a swimming pool, sky deck, and a climbing wall downstairs.

The space
You'll enter into an open living and dining area with a full kitchen, 65" smart TV, and a Juliet-style door overlooking the pool and courtyard. The bedroom features a king bed, 50" smart TV, walk-in closet, and blackout curtains. A queen sleeper sofa and two twin roll-out beds in the living space bring total sleeping capacity to 6. The unit also has a well-lit bathroom and includes your own full-size washer and dryer.

Guest access
You'll have full access to the entire apartment, plus the building's resort-style pool, sky deck, fitness center, indoor rock climbing wall, and coworking space. Pool and courtyard access requires your reservation name to match photo ID — please have it ready.

Other things to note
Parking: A dedicated on-site parking space is available for $30/night. Please let me know in advance if you'd like to add parking to your stay. A public parking garage is also available for $40/day, payable at the garage kiosk.

No pets (building-wide policy).

STR Permit #2018070967.
